development: Seven failed October BUY decisions; known October cohort is development only
hypotheses: Replace risk-multiple target fabrication with a past-only horizon-specific empirical range anchored to the last completed close.
Do not reset remaining upside when the live entry price has already extended.
First-day breakouts require distinct verified continuation or a held retest; pending evidence remains researchable.
Keep every original cash, risk, fee, net-return and reward-risk threshold.

candidate_method.forward_windows: non-overlapping completed windows, all ending before decision
candidate_method.scope: historical range envelope, not a calibrated win probability

validation.universe_rule: 20 equally spaced by stock code among 2025-12-31 liquid affordable four-digit ordinary shares, excluding all original seed and scout symbols
validation.numeric_protocol: Every eligible next-session open, only previous completed daily data; entry-day high/low not used as signal
validation.execution_scope: Historical ordinary-market price-path proxy; no invented odd-lot quotes, fills or full-market recall

acceptance: Keep modeled-target opportunities and real positive cases visible; all-WAIT is not a pass.
Report both wrong buys and missed reference opportunities using a fixed baseline denominator.
Keep uncertain entry, ambiguous daily barrier order and missing data explicit.
